name: northbeam-triage
description: Classify Northbeam Software support tickets into a category and priority according to the company triage policy.
datagen_guidance: The ticket must genuinely belong to the target category under the policy (dominant issue rule included), and the priority must be derived from the policy rules, not from how urgent the customer sounds.

personas: office manager at a dental practice
operations lead at a 40-person e-commerce startup
freelance designer who bills through the product
IT admin managing SSO for a nonprofit
project manager at a construction firm
customer success rep whose own team uses the tool
warehouse supervisor coordinating shifts in the app
tones: written by a non-native English speaker
wrinkles: mentions a second, minor unrelated annoyance in passing
includes a made-up order or invoice number
names a specific coworker who is also affected
asks how long a fix will take
mentions they are considering a competitor

technical_issue: the problem completely blocks the customer's work and they state there is no workaround
the problem is annoying but the customer mentions a workaround they are using
the problem is cosmetic or intermittent and work continues
billing: a payment failure that has suspended or is about to suspend the workspace
a routine dispute, refund, invoice, or plan-change question with service unaffected
a question about a charge or tax document, no urgency
account_access: an ordinary lockout (password loop, lost 2FA device, SSO misconfigured for them)
an ordinary lockout (password loop, lost 2FA device, SSO misconfigured for them)
an ordinary lockout (password loop, lost 2FA device, SSO misconfigured for them)
signs of unauthorized access to their account (unfamiliar location, changed settings)
